name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.11.0 (LNK SESSION02: LNK05+LNK06 on LNK SESSION01 FIX01 0.10.1). Everything of 0.10.1 (Bokoblin posture, break/punish/Finish, enemy bars, Shield Attack parry +40, Link's bottom posture bar, hidden bottom action prompts, direct hits, life/guard recovery, Blue/Red/Black/fury weights, FIX01 stability) PLUS: when a confirmed block or a confirmed direct hit fills Link's posture to 100 (or lands while it is at 100), Link's guard really breaks with the game's own Guard Break (same native routine the game uses on the 4th consecutive block): native animation, sound and vulnerability; the bar pulses, recovery is held during the break and the bar returns to 0 only after Link really recovers (native cancel/end of the animation). A Shield Attack parry never breaks (+0 Link, +40 enemy). Direct hits never override the native damage reaction (the break waits, bounded). Native guard breaks are adopted, never doubled. Replaces 0.10.1 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
